sources.snippet: Fish Audio Drama 3, converted for the native ComfyUI nodes of ComfyUI-Drama3: a 35B text-to-speech model for voice cloning, dialogue and inline cues such as [sighs] or [whispers], running on cards from 8 GB. 90% of the model is routed experts and each audio frame uses only 8 of the 256 in a layer, so the nodes keep the experts in system RAM and a cache of the ones in use on the GPU.
